title: Equal Sum Arrays With Minimum Number of Operations
goal: Make two dice-valued arrays have equal sums using as few value changes as possible.
strategy: Each smaller-side value can increase to six, and each larger-side value can decrease to one. Use those independent gains in decreasing order to close the sum gap fastest.
